messages:
Anna: Heads-up — ACME (tenant acme-73) reporting hourly usage missing for a ~4–6h window starting around 03:00 UTC. Customer says charts show zeros between 03:00–08:00 UTC.
Priya (ACME): Yep, noticed this on our side. Billing exports also look low. Any ETA?
Anna: Investigating now. Rob — can you check ETL consumers and backfill logs for acme-73? Last good upsert I see ~02:58 UTC.
deploy-bot: consumer-group 'usage-rollup' rebalance at 2026-03-12T03:12:04Z — leader change detected.
Rob: Checking — consumer lag spiked at ~03:00. cdc-consumer for partition 12 crashed at 03:05 with error: "schema mismatch: missing field tenant_metadata". Consumer restarted; rollup backfill kicked but failed later with constraint violations.
Jae: Pulled etl-backfill pod logs — backfill job had FK/unique constraint errors on usage.daily_rollups: duplicate key (tenant_id,hour). Partial writes then retry caused collisions and the job didn't mark offsets, so rollup skipped hours 03–06.
Anna: That lines up with the customer's missing hours. Priya — does this affect any immediate billing runs?
Priya (ACME): Billing not finalized yet but daily totals will be off if not corrected. Need a workaround asap.
Rob: Short-term: run a targeted backfill for tenant acme-73 for 03:00–07:00 with dedupe-on-upsert. Kicking off: 
  `rdw-backfill --tenant acme-73 --start 2026-03-12T03:00Z --end 2026-03-12T07:00Z --dedupe=true`
deploy-bot: backfill-job/rdw-backfill-1769991250 started on cluster 'prod-etl' (node group etl-workers).
Jae: Also pushed a hotfix to etl-schema-checker to fail-fast on schema drift to avoid partial writes. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/etl/pull/421
Rob: Backfill finished: inserted ~2,039 rows, deduped 40 duplicates, rollup rehydration enqueued. Console rehydration queue shows jobs for acme-73 hours 03–06.
Anna: Priya — please check the dashboard; it should start filling in within ~10 minutes once rehydration runs. Sorry for the disruption.
Priya (ACME): I'm seeing numbers coming back in — thank you. Please make sure billing stream doesn't undercount; we'll verify.
Jae: Follow-ups I'm adding: postmortem + compensating migration to mark offsets so the pipeline doesn't skip; alert for partial-backfill failures; add check to backfill job to make writes idempotent.
Rob: Filing tickets: RDW-830 (dedupe on upsert), RDW-831 (job-level checkpointing), RDW-832 (alert for backfill runtime > 30m).
Anna: Thanks all. I'll keep customer updated and loop in billing for credits if needed. Closing after postmortem. :thumbsup:
